description: Send pre-graduation curve shares of a MomoSwap launch to another wallet (address or .cook name) — `transfer` cannot, because shares are program-tracked positions, not tokens. The cost basis moves with them pro rata (it counts toward the recipient's per-wallet cap). Only while the launch is live and past its first-minute anti-snipe window; a first send to a wallet with no position must be at least a minimum buy's worth; the sender pays the recipient position's rent. IRREVERSIBLE: a recipient never used on chain (what a mistyped address looks like) is refused unless `allowUnusedRecipient: true`. The launchpad builds the transaction; it is checked instruction by instruction to be exactly this transfer, then simulated. Paired launches have no shares (send their tokens with transfer). Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

allowUnusedRecipient.description: send even though the recipient has never been used on chain — only after confirming the address

ref.description: the token mint or the launchpad pool address (either works)

shares.description: how many shares to send, as a UI token amount

name: transfer_launchpad_shares
